title: 中考英语语篇填空考点精讲与知识索引

overview.description: 语法填空题一共有 10 个空，其中 6~7 个空考查实词（有提示词），3~4 个空考查虚词（无提示词）。主要考查语法、词法及句法成分分析能力。

strategies.title: 有提示词——“一看二思”解题法
strategies.summary: 先看给的是什么词（动词/名词/代词/形容词/副词），再思考转化方向（时态语态/非谓语/派生/单复数/所有格/比较级）。

strategies.title: 无提示词——“二定”解题法
strategies.summary: 先定填哪类词（代词/介词/冠词/连词/从属关联词），再结合上下文语境和固定搭配确定填什么词。

points.name: 可数名词变复数
points.rule: 当所给词是单数可数名词时，且空前有 2 及以上数字或者 some、many、few、all、several、one of、these、those、other 等修饰词时，名词要用复数形式。
points.example: Firemen work in shifts and each shift lasts twenty-four 37. ________ (hour). -> hours

points.name: 名词变所有格
points.rule: 当所给提示词是名词，且修饰空后的名词时，意为“……的”，该空需填名词所有格形式（'s / s'）。注意 woman / man 修饰复数名词时变 women / men。
points.example: The effective methods in TCM also took my 6. _________ (wife) interest. -> wife's

points.name: 名词派生形容词/动词
points.rule: 由名词派生为形容词或动词（如 China -> Chinese, care -> careful 等）。
points.example: In the hearts of 3. ________ (China) people... -> Chinese

points.name: 谓语动词时态
points.rule: 当所给词是动词，且作谓语时，利用设空所在句的时态标志词（如 Last night, since 2 years ago, so far）、前后语境以及并列结构确定时态。
points.example: When they 36. ________ (return), Uncle Jason told me... -> returned

points.name: 谓语动词语态（被动语态）
points.rule: 先根据语境确定时态，再分析主语与动词的主被动关系（主语是动作承受者时用 be + done），注意提示词 by。
points.example: Uncle Jason 38. _____ (send) to offer help. -> was sent

points.name: 非谓语动词：不定式 (to do)
points.rule: 不定式主要考查：作宾语 (decide/want/plan/hope to do)、作目的状语 (意为'为了……')、作定语 (the way/chance to do) 等。
points.example: They must stay strong 33. ________ (save) people. -> to save

points.name: 非谓语动词：动名词与-ing
points.rule: 动词放在介词后需用 -ing 形式 (after arriving, before running)；或用于固定搭配 (enjoy/spend time/practise doing)。
points.example: He spent too much time 4. ________ (read) books... -> reading

points.name: 动词派生与词类转换
points.rule: 根据句子成分与语法功能，动词通过添加前后缀转化为名词（如 improve -> improvement, develop -> development, paint -> painter, visit -> visitor）或形容词（如 use -> useful, tire -> tired）。
points.example: ...wants to make some 9. ________ (improve) to his invention. -> improvements

points.name: 比较级与最高级
points.rule: 比较级：题后有 than 或题前有 even/much/far 时用比较级；最高级：题前有 the 且句中有 in/of 表示范围时用最高级。
points.example: In my heart, he has become 40. ________ (great) than ever before. -> greater

points.name: 形容词变副词
points.rule: 副词修饰动词 (v.+adv. / adv.+v.)、修饰形容词 (adv.+adj.) 或位于句首修饰整个句子 (adv., 句子)。
points.example: ...an emergency call 35. _________ (sudden) came in... -> suddenly

points.name: 形容词/副词反义前缀与派生
points.rule: 根据上下文语境否定或相反含义，添加否定前缀（如 fair -> unfair, possible -> impossible）。
points.example: 9. ________ (fair) trade was quite common. -> Unfair

points.name: 形容词派生名词
points.rule: 根据句意或介词后成分，形容词转化为名词（如 happy -> happiness）。
points.example: This is the secret of 10. ________ (happy)... -> happiness

points.name: 基数词变序数词
points.rule: 当所给词为基数词，空前有 the/物主代词/所有格，空后为单数名词，表示“第几……”时填序数词（one -> first, six -> sixth）。
points.example: Of course, it became our family's 3. _________ (one) home computer. -> first

points.name: 人称代词主格变宾格
points.rule: 当代词用在介词或动词之后作宾语时，用其宾格形式（we -> us, they -> them, he -> him）。
points.example: Both of 6. ________ (they) had snake bodies... -> them

points.name: 物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
points.rule: 修饰空后名词用形容词性物主代词（he -> his, we -> our）；空后无名词独立使用时用名词性物主代词。
points.example: Uncle Jason says the hardest part for him is being away from 39. ______ (he) family. -> his

points.name: 反身代词 (oneself)
points.rule: 当所给代词和主语指同一人/物，或表达“亲自”“独自”时用反身代词（you -> yourself/yourselves, she -> herself, on one's own）。
points.example: She never expected 1. ________ (her) to become a tea master... -> herself

points.name: 不定冠词 (a / an)
points.rule: 单数可数名词泛指，辅音音素前用 a，元音音素前用 an（如 an average student, an empty bowl, a choice）；常考固定短语 a number of, a pair of。
points.example: There are 32. ____ number of fire trucks in it... -> a

points.name: 定冠词 (the)
points.rule: 特指前文提过的人/物、独一无二的事物、序数词/最高级前、方向方位介词短语及固定短语 (the same as, the first few days)。
points.example: However, in 7. ________ first few days... -> the

categories.name: 七、连词与关联词 (无提示词)

points.name: 并列连词 (and / but / or / so)
points.rule: 连接并列单词、短语或句子，判断并列顺承 (and)、转折 (but)、选择 (or)、因果 (so)；注意固定搭配 both...and, either...or, not only...but also。
points.example: ...both heavy 34. ____ hot! -> and

points.name: 从属连词与状语从句
points.rule: 引导状语从句：时间 (when, while, as, before, after, since)、原因 (because, as)、条件 (if, unless)、让步 (although, though)。
points.example: 1. ________ he wanted to make his son have a happy life... -> Because / As

points.name: 宾语从句/疑问连接词 (how / what / that)
points.rule: 连接疑问词引导的从句或不定式复合结构（如 show sb. how to do sth., show how important...）。
points.example: She showed foreigners 5. ________ to brew tea... -> how

categories.name: 八、介词与固定搭配 (无提示词)

points.name: 介词固定搭配与基本用法
points.rule: 考查常用动介/形介搭配（be proud of, benefit from, be good at, full of, fill...with, from...to, with the help of, fall in love with）及时间/方位介词（in, on, at）。
points.example: A model plane competition was held in his town 10. ________ May 1st, 2024. -> on
